evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Using the Petri tool to audit LLM coding agents, we test the impact of providing two types of resources (an external codebase and benchmark transcripts) to LLM auditors, across four auditor-target LLM pairs and three behaviours (harmful compliance, reward hacking, sycophancy). (1) External codebase: We provide the auditor LLM with a fixed, external open source codebase, which prior work finds improves the realism of synthetic audits.

evidence.excerpt: We hope our results inspire more research into the reliability and robustness of automated alignment auditing.
